name: Meetings
description: Keeps each person's meeting records, personal notes and recording defaults private to their account. Create, rename, delete and take versioned notes on meetings, and set recording defaults. Transcripts, History search, recording types and pasted transcripts are included. Summaries written by the configured model, with edits, history and an automatic summary after a pasted transcript, are included. Each action a summary proposes can be accepted into Tasks or dismissed. A summary version can be saved as a private copy in your notes, once, and a copy you edited is never overwritten. Your account export holds every meeting collection, including the stored audio of finished recording imports. Recording and the Meetings screen are not part of this package yet.

settings.label: Meetings
settings.description: Recording audio, transcript language, vocabulary and automatic summary defaults are saved with your account. Changing them from Settings is not available in this version yet; they can be read and saved through the Meetings routes.

features.description: Each person keeps private meeting records with a title and personal notes. Titles are at most 240 bytes and notes at most 64,000 bytes. Notes save with a version check, so a stale edit is refused and returns the current notes. A repeated request key returns the original result. Deleting a meeting is permanent. Nobody else, including admins, can see them.

features.description: Saves the default recording audio, the remembered recording source, automatic summaries on Stop, the summary style, the transcript language and best-effort vocabulary for the account. Reading never creates a default. The Meetings screen and Settings controls are not part of this package yet.

features.description: Saves a meeting transcript as numbered batches and reads it back. A batch is applied in order, a repeated request key returns the original receipt, and a stale version is refused. Reads return at most 500 segments and 100,000 characters, and a single segment can be read as evidence with a character range. A meeting holds at most 4,096 batches, 20,000 revisions and 32 MiB. Only the meeting owner can save or read, and admins cannot.

features.description: Each person keeps a list of recording types (at most 32, names up to 80 characters, descriptions up to 500) and picks one for each meeting. A save must keep every existing type, so a type is retired instead of removed, and a stale save is refused. A pasted transcript (up to 100,000 characters) creates a meeting with its transcript in one step, and a repeated request key returns the first answer. A pasted transcript also starts an automatic summary. Replies are never cached, and nobody else, including admins, can see any of it.

features.description: Turns one recorded clip into timed text using the speech service you set up for your account. The clip goes only to that service, the module cannot pick the service or model, and a changed setup stops the request before or after it is sent. A clip is at most 3,840,044 bytes, and one reply carries at most 10,000 segments. Nothing about the audio or the text is written to activity records. Nobody else, including admins, can use your speech setup.

features.description: Finds your own meetings by words in the title, notes or transcript, with filters for transcript, needs review, exported and notes only, and pages through them newest first. A search can use at most 16 words. Replies are never cached, and nobody else, including admins, sees your meetings.

features.description: A summary of a meeting is written by the model you configured from your own notes and transcript, using one of four templates. Only your meeting text is sent to the model, and every cited quote is checked against the transcript before the summary is saved. Accepting a proposed action makes one task in Tasks from the title you confirm, and accepting again never makes a second. A possible match with an earlier action needs your confirmation first. Each save is a new numbered version that is never changed, and an edit saves a new version after the same checks. A summary is marked stale when the notes or transcript change afterwards. A repeated request key returns the first answer. Nobody else, including admins, can see any of it.

features.description: A pasted transcript starts a summary on its own, using the recording type's template or the general one. The summary is skipped when the meeting already has one, the transcript changed, or there is no readable text, and the screen says which. The background job carries only the meeting id.

features.description: A summary version can be saved once as a private copy in your own notes. The copy is created only when you ask, never overwritten, and a copy you edited or removed is reported as a conflict instead of being replaced. A repeated request key returns the first answer. Notes cannot search private copies yet, so the receipt shows the search step as delayed. Nobody else, including admins, can see any of it.

features.description: After a summary run, the model reads the recording and files its type, a title for an untitled meeting, whether it is personal or work, a confidence and a reason. A person's own type choice and title are kept. The model also gets background about the owner from Calendar and People, within fixed size limits, and treats it as evidence only. A reading below 80% confidence posts a chat message that names the side and links to the recording. Each idea in the reading is proposed to Memory as a fact through its public API, and Memory keeps work and personal facts apart. The Meetings screen is not part of this package yet.
